scenes.say: Travel agents. Quote bheja, customer bola thoda sasta, aur phir gayab?
Ek quote pe customer haan ya na sochta hai. Teen option pe sochta hai kaunsa lena hai.

scenes.title: 1. Quote *aise* bhejo:
scenes.name: Your Travels

msgs.text:
Goa 4N/5D, 2 adults 🌴
🥉 *Budget* ₹28,500: 3★, breakfast
🥈 *Best value* ₹36,900: 4★ beach, airport cab
🥇 *Premium* ₹52,000: 5★, sab meals

scenes.say: Teen option. Beech wala sabse zyaada bikta hai.

scenes.title: 2. *Uske baad*:
scenes.say: Uske baad itinerary, booking confirm, aur trip se ek din pehle checklist.
Sabse badi galti. Customer ke maangne se pehle discount de dena.
Comment karo QUOTE, teen option wala template bhejenge. Ya seedha WhatsApp karo, hum aapke liye set kar denge.

caption:
Travel agent ka sabse common dukh: quote bheja, "thoda sasta?", phir chup. ✈️

2️⃣ Beech wala sabse zyaada bikta hai
3️⃣ Same din itinerary PDF, advance pe confirm screenshot, trip se pehle checklist
❌ Galti: maangne se pehle discount
